purpose: Update local Marshall aviation while the fast-carrier battle diverts part of TF58 from a full third suppression cycle.

US_3Feb_local_pressure.reason: A planned heavier third suppression cycle is truncated/diverted once the Japanese carrier raid and counterstrike demand dominate TF58 operations.

C2: Taroa/Roi remain C+/B- or worse in intermittent windows. Water-air alternates preserve limited cue-to-confirm capability even when main runways are cratered.
search_capacity: 2-3 useful local confirmation/search sorties per day centered after 3-Feb losses; strategic search increasingly depends on submarines/regional assets.
assessment: The Japanese fleet-carrier intervention buys the Marshall air network a partial breathing interval but does not restore local air superiority or repair the damaged radar/runway system.
